messages:
lisa-sales: BigBank POC ask: EU control plane, inference inside their Canada datacenter, BYO-KMS (possible HSM), zero external egress for payloads. Need feasibility, SOW delta, and ops checklist. Who can weigh in?

alex-eng: technically fine with Redwood Private + customer-managed data plane. If weights must stay on-prem, we deliver a self-hosted runtime package; control plane only holds metadata. Telemetry can be disabled but impacts debugging.

maria-privacy: pls confirm sub-processor list and whether HSM is mandatory. If HSM required, extra validation and paperwork. We can produce KMS flow diagrams in ~72h once confirmed.

jon-sre: network/certs: mutual TLS required between control plane and on-prem agent. Proposed routing snippet:

```yaml
routing:
  control_plane: eu-west1
  data_plane: onprem (ca-central1)
  failover: disabled unless customer approves cross-border
  egress_restrict: true
```

jon-sre: ETA: 2-3 days for cert rotation + monitoring hooks; add 4 days for airgap installer.

lisa-sales: ballpark costs? one-time vs recurring?

alex-eng: rough SOW numbers:
- Private deployment fee: +$6,000/mo
- On-prem packaging (one-time): $28k
- BYO-KMS integration: $8k (HSM add-on +$10k)
- Ops onboarding & runbook: $4k
Estimate first-month uplift ~ $40k($50k with HSM). Recurring +$6k/mo.

sam-account: noted  will draft SOW lines and check tax treatment for Canada.

maria-privacy: security note: if they demand "no telemetry", we can offer a minimal health heartbeat only; full logs/metrics must be explicitly allowed for our debugging support.

lisa-sales: Actions: 1) @alex-eng confirm whether any metadata must live in EU control plane (EOD). 2) @maria-privacy provide sub-processor + KMS flow (72h). 3) @jon-sre provide cert rotation plan + ops ETA (3d). 4) @sam-account draft SOW items. I'll set customer call tomorrow.

deploy-bot: INF-7001 created: "bigbank-byo-kms-onprem-poc"  assignees: alex-eng, jon-sre  due: 3d.

alex-eng: I'll add a secure artifact transfer pattern for model updates (signed tars over SFTP) to the ticket.

lisa-sales: thanks all, will send the checklist and sync invite.
